name: tweek
title: Tweek Task Manager
description: Manage your Tweek calendars, tasks, someday lists, and recurring todos directly from Raycast and Raycast AI (@tweek).
author: Bykush

ai.instructions: You are the Tweek Task Manager AI assistant (@tweek). Use `get-calendars` to discover the user's calendars and Someday lists, and `get-tasks` to inspect Today's, This Week's, Overdue, or Someday tasks before modifying tasks. When creating tasks with `create-task`, support relative dates ('today', 'tomorrow', 'someday') or YYYY-MM-DD and Tweek color badges ('blank', 'pink', 'yellowish', 'cornflower', 'mango', 'greenish', 'lilac', 'grey', 'black'). For recurring occurrences (`<taskId>_yyyyMMdd`), ask or default to `only_this` unless the user specifies `this_and_future` or `all_linked`.

evals.input: @tweek What tasks do I have scheduled for today and this week?

tools.name: get-calendars
tools.title: Get Tweek Calendars & Colors
tools.description: Lists all Tweek calendars, Someday lists, and custom colors available in the user's account.

tools.name: get-tasks
tools.title: Get Tweek Tasks
tools.description: Fetches Tweek tasks by calendar, date preset (today, this_week, overdue, someday, all), date range, or keyword search.

tools.name: create-task
tools.title: Create Tweek Task
tools.description: Creates a new task in Tweek with optional date (today, tomorrow, someday, or YYYY-MM-DD), color badge, note, and subtasks.

tools.name: update-task
tools.title: Update Tweek Task
tools.description: Updates an existing Tweek task's title, date, color badge, note, or recurring series scope.

tools.name: complete-task
tools.title: Complete Tweek Task
tools.description: Marks a Tweek task or recurring occurrence as completed or pending.

tools.name: delete-task
tools.title: Delete Tweek Task
tools.description: Deletes a Tweek task or recurring series occurrence after user confirmation.
